heading: prastavna: vidyut urja ka jeevan mein mahatva
paras: vidyut urja hamare jeevan mein bahut mahatvapurn bhumika nibhati hai. yeh hamare gharo mein prakash vyavastha ke liye bulb jalati hai, hamare fridge ko chalti rakhti hai, aur hamare mobile phone ko aavesh deti hai.
vidyut urja ke bina hamara jeevan bahut mushkil ho jayega. hamein vidyut urja ke mahatva ko samajhna chahiye aur iska sahi tareeke se upyog karna chahiye.
vidyut urja ke bare mein jaanne ke liye hamein vidyut dhara aur vidyut aavesh ke bare mein jaanna hoga. vidyut dhara electrons ki gati hai, aur vidyut aavesh electrons ki matra hai.
example: vidyut urja ko samajhne ke liye ek udaharan lete hain. jab aap apne mobile phone ko aaveshit karte hain, to vidyut urja aapke phone mein jati hai aur ise chalane ke liye upyog ki jati hai.

heading: paath 1: vidyut aavesh aur vidyut dhara
paras: vidyut aavesh electrons ki matra hai. yeh do prakaar ka hota hai - dhanatmak aur rinitmak. jab do vastuayein ek dusre ke sampark mein aati hain, to ve electrons ko ek dusre mein sthanantarit kar sakti hain.
vidyut dhara electrons ki gati hai, jo ek **chalaak** se hokar guzarti hai. ham iski maap ke liye **ammeter** ka upyog karte hain.
vidyut dhara ki ikai ampere hai. vidyut dhara ko Q/t se vyakt kiya ja sakta hai, jahan Q aavesh hai aur t samay hai.
example: ek udaharan lete hain. jab aap ek bulb ko jalate hain, to vidyut dhara bulb se hokar guzarti hai aur ise jalane ke liye upyog ki jati hai.

heading: paath 2: vidyut vibhav aur vibhavantar
paras: vidyut vibhav ek bindu par vidyut kshetra ki teevrata ko mapta hai. yeh ek **voltmeter** se mapta ja sakta hai.
vibhavantar do binduon ke beech vidyut vibhav ka antar hai, jo vidyut dhara ke pravah ko niyantrit karta hai.
vibhavantar ki ikai volt hai. vibhavantar ko V = W/q se vyakt kiya ja sakta hai, jahan V vibhavantar hai, W karya hai, aur q aavesh hai.
example: ek udaharan ke roop mein, jab aap ek battery se ek bulb ko jalate hain, to battery aur bulb ke beech vibhavantar vidyut dhara ke pravah ko sambhav banata hai.

heading: Path 3: Paripath Pratik, Ammeter aur Voltmeter
paras: Paripath pratik vidhyut paripath ko darshane ke liye upyog kiye jate hain. Ve vidhyut dhar ke pravah ko samajhne mein madad karte hain.
Ammeter vidhyut dhar ko mapne ke liye upyog kiya jata hai. Yeh paripath mein shrnikram mein joda jata hai.
Voltmeter vibhavantar ko mapne ke liye upyog kiya jata hai. Yeh paripath mein parshvkram mein joda jata hai.
example: Ek udaharan leta hai. Jab aap ek paripath mein ammeter aur voltmeter ka upyog karte hain, to aap vidhyut dhar aur vibhavantar ko map sakte hain aur vidhyut paripath ko samajh sakte hain.

heading: Path 4: Ohm ka Niyam aur V-I Rekha Chitra Vishleshan
paras: Ohm ka niyam ek moolbhoot siddhant hai jo kisi conductor mein vidhyut dhar aur vibhavantar ke beech sambandh ko darshata hai.
Is niyam ke anusaar, yadi kisi conductor ka pratirodh niyat rahta hai, to vidhyut dhar vibhavantar ke seedhe anupat mein hoti hai.
Ohm ka niyam ek voltmeter aur ammeter ka upyog karke prayogshala mein satyapit kiya ja sakta hai.
V-I rekha chitra vishleshan se humein kisi conductor ke pratirodh ke man ki ganana karne mein madad milti hai.
Is prakaar, Ohm ka niyam aur V-I rekha chitra vishleshan humein vidhyut dhar aur vibhavantar ke beech sambandh ko samajhne mein madad karte hain.
example: Ek udaharan ke roop mein, yadi aap ek vidhyut bulb ko 5 volt ke vibhavantar par 2 ampere ka vidhyut dhar pravahit karte hain, to bulb ka pratirodh 2.5 ohm hoga.

heading: Path 5: Conductor ka Pratirodh aur uske Prabhavit Karne Wale Kak
paras: Kisi conductor ka pratirodh uski lambai, anuprasth kaat, aur taap par nirbhar karta hai.
Ek conductor ki lambai badhane se uska pratirodh badh jata hai, jabki anuprasth kaat badhane se pratirodh kam ho jata hai.
Taap mein parivartan se bhi conductor ka pratirodh prabhavit hota hai. Adhikansh conductor ka pratirodh taap badhne par badh jata hai.
In kakon ko samajhne se humein vibhinn vidhyut paripath mein pratirodh ki ganana karne mein madad milti hai.
Is prakaar, conductor ka pratirodh aur uske prabhavit karne wale kakon ka gyan humein vidhyut pranali ko design aur vishleshan karne mein madad karta hai.
example: Ek udaharan ke roop mein, yadi aap ek taar ko garm karte hain, to uska pratirodh badh jayega aur vidhyut dhar kam ho jayegi.

heading: Paath 6: Padaarthon ki pratirodhkta (chaalak, mishradhaatu aur vidyutrodi)
paras: Pratyek padaarthon ki ek vishisht pratirodhkta hoti hai, jo uske pratirodh ko nirdhaarit karti hai.
Chaalak jaise taamba aur chaandi ki pratirodhkta kam hoti hai, jabki vidyutrodi jaise plastic aur lakdi ki pratirodhkta uchch hoti hai.
Mishradhaatu jaise peetal aur loha ki pratirodhkta unke ghatak padaarthon par nirbhar karti hai.
In padaarthon ki pratirodhkta ko samajhne se humein vibhinn vidyut paripath mein pratirodh ki ganana karne mein madad milti hai.
Is prakaar, padaarthon ki pratirodhkta ka gyaan humein vidyut pranaali ko design aur vishleshan karne mein madad karta hai.
example: Ek udaaharan ke roop mein, yadi aap ek taar ko banaane ke liye taamba ka upyog karte hain, to uski pratirodhkta kam hogi aur vidyut dhaara adhik hogi.

heading: paath 7: pratirodhakon ka shrenikram sanyojan
paras: do ya do se adhik **pratirodhak** [resistor] jab shrenikram mein jude hote hain, to unka kul **pratirodh** [resistance] vyaktigat **pratirodhak** [resistor] ke **pratirodh** [resistance] ke yog ke barabar hota hai.

shrenikram sanyojan mein, **vidyut dhara** [electric current] sabhi **pratirodhak** [resistor] mein saman hoti hai, lekin **vibhavantar** [potential difference] alag-alag **pratirodhak** [resistor] mein vibhinn ho sakta hai.
shrenikram sanyojan ka upyog **vidyut paripath** [electric circuit] mein **vidyut dhara** [electric current] aur **vibhavantar** [potential difference] ko niyantrit karne ke liye kiya ja sakta hai.
is prakar, **pratirodhak** [resistor] ka shrenikram sanyojan humein **vidyut pranali** [electric system] ko design aur vishleshan karne mein madad karta hai.
shrenikram sanyojan ke gunon ko samajhne se humein **vidyut paripath** [electric circuit] mein **pratirodh** [resistance] aur **vidyut dhara** [electric current] ki ganana karne mein madad milti hai.
example: ek udaharan ke roop mein, yadi aap do **pratirodhak** [resistor] 2 ohm aur 3 ohm ko shrenikram mein jodte hain, to unka kul **pratirodh** [resistance] 5 ohm hoga.

heading: paath 8: pratirodhakon ka parshvkrama sanyojan
paras: pratirodhakon ka parshvkrama sanyojan ek aisi vyavastha hai jismein do ya do se adhik pratirodhak ek saath jude hote hain, lekin unke anupasth kat ek dusre ke samantar hote hain.
is sanyojan mein, yadi ek pratirodhak mein vidyut dhara ka pravah hota hai, to yeh anya pratirodhakon par koi prabhav nahi dalta hai.
pratirodhakon ke parshvkrama sanyojan ka upyog vidyut paripathon mein kiya jata hai jahan vibhinn upkaranon ko alag-alag vibhavantar par chalane ki avashyakta hoti hai.
ek gharelu vidyut paripath mein, pratirodhakon ka parshvkrama sanyojan is tarah se kiya ja sakta hai ki pratyek upkaran ko uske anusar vibhavantar prapt ho.
is prakar, pratirodhakon ka parshvkrama sanyojan vidyut paripathon mein bahut upyogi hota hai.
example: maan lijiye ki aapke paas do pratirodhak hain - ek 2 ohm aur dusra 3 ohm. yadi aap inhen parshvkrama mein jodte hain, to paripath ka kul pratirodh kya hoga?

heading: Paath 9: Gharelu vidyut paripath: shrenikram banaam paarshvkram
paras: Gharelu vidyut paripath mein vidyut upkarnon ko jodne ke liye do prakaar ke sanjogon ka upyog kiya ja sakta hai - shrenikram aur paarshvkram.
Shrenikram sanjog mein, sabhi upkaran ek ke baad ek jude hote hain aur vidyut dhaara ek hi maarg se guzarti hai.
Paarshvkram sanjog mein, upkaran samaantaar mein jude hote hain aur vidyut dhaara alag-alag maargon se guzarti hai.
Shrenikram sanjog ka upyog tab kiya jaata hai jab sabhi upkarnon ko ek hi vibhvaantar par chalaane ki aavashyakta hoti hai.
Paarshvkram sanjog ka upyog tab kiya jaata hai jab vibhinn upkarnon ko alag-alag vibhvaantar par chalaane ki aavashyakta hoti hai.
example: Gharelu vidyut paripath mein shrenikram aur paarshvkram sanjogon ka upyog upkarnon ki aavashyaktaon ke anusaar kiya jaata hai.

heading: paath 10: vidyut dhara ka taapey prabhav aur jul ka niyam
paras: vidyut dhara ka taapey prabhav yeh hai ki jab yeh kisi chalaak mein pravahit hoti hai, to chalaak ka taapman badh jata hai.
yeh taapey prabhav vidyut urja ke roopantaran ke karan hota hai, jismein vidyut urja taap urja mein parivartit ho jati hai.
jul ka niyam kehta hai ki kisi chalaak mein utpann hone wali taap urja vidyut dhara ke varg aur chalaak ke pratirodh ke gunank ke samanupati hoti hai.
jul ka niyam ko is tarah samjhaaya ja sakta hai: taap urja ki matra vidyut dhara ke varg aur pratirodh serta samay ke gunank ke barabar hoti hai, jaisa ki Q = I^2Rt sutra mein dikhaya gaya hai.
vidyut dhara ka taapey prabhav aur jul ka niyam vidyut paripathon ke design aur sanchalan mein bahut mahatvapurn hain.
example: ek vidyut heater ke maamle mein, yadi yeh 5 A ki vidyut dhara ko 20 ohm ke pratirodh ke sath 10 minute tak chalaya jata hai, to yeh kitni taap urja paida karega?

heading: Lesson 11: Vidhyut Tantru Bulb aur Fuse ka Karya-Siddhant
paras: Vidhyut tantru bulb mein ek patla tantru hota hai jo vidhyut dhara ke pravaah se garm ho jata hai aur prakash utpann karta hai.
Fuse ek aisa upkaran hai jo vidhyut paripath mein adhik vidhyut dhara ke pravaah ko rokta hai aur paripath ki suraksha karta hai.
Vidhyut tantru bulb aur fuse dono vidhyut dhara ke taapik prabhaav par kary karte hain.
Vidhyut tantru bulb mein tantru ka pratirodh itna adhik hota hai ki jab vidhyut dhara pravahit hoti hai, to vah tantru garm ho jata hai aur prakash utpann karta hai.
Fuse mein ek patla taar hota hai jo adhik vidhyut dhara ke pravaah se garm ho jata hai aur pighal jata hai, jisse paripath toot jata hai.
example: Vidhyut tantru bulb aur fuse dono vidhyut dhara ke taapik prabhaav par kary karte hain aur vidhyut paripathon mein bahut mahatvapoorn hain.

heading: paath 12: vidyut shakti tatha vyaavasaayik urja ki ganana
paras: vidyut shakti [electric power] ka arth hai vidyut urja [energy] ki dar se khapat. yeh vidyut dhara [electric current] aur vibhavantar [potential difference] par nirbhar karti hai.
vidyut shakti ki ganana karne ke liye, hum vidyut dhara aur vibhavantar ko guna karte hain. yeh ek mahatvapurn sutra hai jo humein vidyut shakti ki ganana karne mein madad karta hai.
vyaavasaayik urja ki ganana karne ke liye, hum vidyut shakti aur samay ko guna karte hain. yeh humein vidyut urja ki khapat ki jankari deta hai.
formula: विद्युत शक्ति [electric power] = विद्युत धारा [electric current] × विभवांतर [potential difference]
example: ek ghar mein 100 watt ka bulb 10 ghante tak jalta hai. to iski vidyut urja ki khapat kitni hogi?

heading: Hal Kie Gaye Udaharan
paras: **Vidhyut Paripath mein Vidhyut Dhara ki Ganana:** Aavesh (charge) Q = 300 C, samay (time) t = 300 s → vidhyut dhara (electric current) I = 1 A hai.
**Ohm ke Niyam se Dhara Gyanat Karana:** Vibhavantr (potential difference) V = 12 V, pratirodh (resistance) R = 4 ohm → parinaami vidhyut dhara (electric current) 3 A hai.
**Parshvakram mein Tuly Pratirodh ki Ganana:** Pratirodhak (resistor) R1 = 6 ohm, pratirodhak R2 = 3 ohm → parshvakram sanyojan mein tuly pratirodh 2 ohm hai.

heading: Saransh (Quick Revision)
paras: **Vidhyut Dhara:** Vidhyut dhara ki paribhasha samay ke saath pravahit aavesh ki dar se judi hoti hai. Iski maap ki ek maanak ikai hai.
**Vibhavantr:** Ekank aavesh ko ek bindu se dusre bindu tak le jaane mein kiya gaya kaam (work) vibhavantr (potential difference) kahalata hai. Iska SI maatrak volt (V) hai.
**Ohm ka Niyam:** Niyaat taap (temperature) par, chalak (conductor) se pravahit dhara usme utpann vibhavantr (V) ke samanupati hoti hai: V = I × R.
**Pratirodhakta:** Pratirodhakta ek aisa gun hai jo bataata hai ki koi padarth vidhyut dhara ka pravah kitna pratirodh karta hai. Iski ek maanak ikai hoti hai.
**Shrenikram Sanyojan:** Shrenikram (series) mein sabhi pratirodhakon se saman dhara pravahit hoti hai aur kul pratirodh Rs = R1 + R2 + R3 hota hai.
**Parshvakram Sanyojan:** Parshvakram (parallel) mein sabhi pratirodhakon par saman vibhavantr hota hai aur 1/Rp = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + 1/R3 hota hai.
**Taapik Prabhaav:** Jab kisi chalak se dhara pravahit hoti hai, to vidhyut urja ka ushma mein roopantaran hota hai. Joule ke niyam se H = I^2 × R × t.
**Fuse:** Ek fuse ek suraksha upkaran hai jo paripath ko nuksaan se bachata hai. Yeh ek nishchit taapmaan par pighal jata hai aur paripath ko tod deta hai.
**Vidhyut Shakti:** Vidhyut urja ke upyog ki dar ko vidhyut shakti (electric power) kehte hain. P = V × I, iska SI maatrak watt (W) hai.
**Vyavsayik Maatrak:** Vidhyut urja ka vyavsayik maatrak kilowatt-ghanta (kWh) ya unit hai. 1 kWh = 3.6 × 10^6 J.

heading: Tvariit Jaanch (Quick Check)
paras: **Ammeter (ammeter) aur Voltmeter (voltmeter) ko Paripath mein Kaise Joda Jata Hai?** — Ammeter ko hamesha **Shrenikram** (series) mein aur voltmeter ko hamesha **Parshvakram** (parallel) mein joda jata hai.

**Chalak (conductor) ka Pratirodh Kin Karkon se Prabhavit Hota Hai?** — Pratirodh chalak ki **Lambai** (length) L ke samanupati, **Anuprasht Kaat** (cross-sectional area) A ke vyutkramanupati tatha **Taap** aur padarth ki prakriti par nirbhar karta hai.

**Gharelu Paripathon (domestic circuits) mein Parshvakram Sanyojan ka Upyog Kyon Kiya Jata Hai?** — Kyonki parshvakram (parallel) mein pratyek upkaran ko saman **Vibhavantr** (potential difference) milta hai aur ek upkaran ke kharab hone par anya kary karte rehte hain.

**Vidhyut Bulb ke Tantru (filament) ke Liye Tungsten ka Upyog Kyon Kiya Jata Hai?** — Kyonki tungsten ki **Pratirodhakta** (resistivity) aur uchch **Galnanak** hota hai, jisse yeh uchch taap par bhi nahin pighalta.
**Fuse (fuse) Taar ki Do Mukhya Visheshataen Likhiye.** — Fuse taar ka **Galnanak** (melting point) kam hota hai tatha **Pratirodh** (resistance) uchch hota hai.

heading: sabhi sutra (Formula Sheet)
paras: विद्युत धारा सूत्र: I = Q / t
विभवांतर सूत्र: V = W / Q
ओम का नियम: V = I × R
प्रतिरोधकता सूत्र: R = rho × L / A
श्रेणीक्रम संयोजन: Rs = R1 + R2 + R3
पार्श्वक्रम संयोजन: 1 / Rp = 1 / R1 + 1 / R2 + 1 / R3
जूल का तापन नियम: H = I^2 × R × t
विद्युत शक्ति सूत्र: P = V × I
विद्युत ऊर्जा सूत्र: E = P × t
